sentences.text: This dinosaur reached a length of about 5 meters and a mass of 600 kilograms, a size attributed to insular dwarfism.
Peasants discovered a Telmatosaurus skull in 1895 at the Săcele estate in Transylvania and gave it to Ilona Nopcsa.
Franz Nopcsa originally named the species Limnosaurus transsylvanicus in 1899.
Nopcsa renamed the genus Telmatosaurus in 1903 after finding that Limnosaurus was already used for a crocodilian described in 1872.
Nopcsa transferred the species to the genus Orthomerus in 1915, naming it Orthomerus transsylvanicus.
The name Telmatosaurus was revived in the 1980s because the genus Orthomerus was considered a nomen dubium.
The presence of an ameloblastoma in a dinosaur suggests that benign tumor development is a basal characteristic.
Because only the lower jaws are preserved, the cause of death for the juvenile Telmatosaurus with the tumor cannot be determined.
Magyar and colleagues named the clade containing Telmatosaurus, Kryptohadros, and Tethyshadros as Telmatosauridae.
The family classification of Telmatosaurus is listed as Hadrosauridae with uncertainty, though it is also considered a member of the clade Telmatosauridae.
Telmatosaurus belongs to the class Ornithischia.
It is debated whether fragmentary hadrosauroid material from Spain, France, Germany, and Romania belongs to Telmatosaurus, as an identity is difficult to prove.
